title: Windsurf vs Claude Code: Which AI Coding Tool Should You Pick in 2026?
summary: Honest comparison of Windsurf and Claude Code in 2026 — pricing, strengths, and why most builders end up choosing a third option: Blink.
body_markdown: Claude Code is built on Anthropic's Claude models — Claude 3.7 Sonnet[scores 70.3% on SWE-bench Verified](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-3-7-sonnet) , among the top coding benchmarks in the industry. Windsurf uses multiple models (Claude, GPT-4o) and doesn't have a single published SWE-bench score. Raw benchmark performance matters most for complex autonomous tasks; for day-to-day editing, both tools perform comparably in practice.[Blink](https://blink.new/) uses the same frontier models (Claude, GPT-4o, Gemini) under the hood for generation.
